༄// bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la brten pa'i sku tshe brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga dbang bcu grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'bum phrag don gzhan 'gog pa'i rgyan/ bskal par 'tsho ba tshe yi dpal// dpag med sbyin pa rgyal ba'i thugs rje che// 'on te sems can re skong mchog rnams kyi// mtshan tsam brjod pa'i yon mtha' gzhal du ci// dus gsum bya ba tha dad pa'i lhan cig brjod pa/ sangs rgyas kun dngos 'dren pa mchog /gsol btab sku tshe bskal brgyar 'phel ba dang*// lhan cig 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i phrin las kyis// rnam 'dren bstan pa dri med phyogs mthar rgyas// gang bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ phyir theg gsum bstan pa'i smra mchog rnams// gsang gsum rdo rjer sgrub pa'i cho ga yis// gsol btab mi bslu nges par dbang bcu pa'i// khyad chos grub pa'i bcud len 'di na spel// 'dir bka' drin zla med skyabs kun 'dus pa rnam 'dren chos kyi rgyal po chen po rnams rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i srog shing du bskal pa du mar zhabs brtan gyi cho ga bsgrub pa la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po sbyor ba ni/ dkyil 'khor zhabs brtan yo byad gnyis// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang legs par brgyan zhing rten gsum byin rlabs can rnams dgram/ gang la zhabs brtan bsgrub pa'i bla ma'i bzhugs khri legs par bshams pa'i g.yas phyogs la sogs pa gang bder stegs kyi khar ras sogs kyis bkab par me tog gi sil mas bkram pa'i steng*/ tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel na legs pas de'i dkyil 'khor ras bris zhal shar du phyogs par bkram pa'i mthar mchod gtor spyi ltar bsham/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma'i bzhugs khri'i mdun logs la sogs pa zhig tu zhabs brtan gyi nyer spyod rnams dang spos mar me zhal zas rnams rgyas pa dang*/

tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung*/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo/ rnam rgyal mchod rten/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnams dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa gnyis mgul chings kha rgyan dung chos gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med pa nyer bsdogs bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rang gi bya ba dang*/ mchog gi yul la bya ba'o// dang po ni/ bdag mdun sgrub mchod bum pa bsgrub// ye shes 'jig rten gtor ma btang*// zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas mchod pa thams cad bsang sbyangs nas dharma ra ṇi rol chen bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang ltar/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed gzhung bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig sogs nas sgrub cing mchod pa bstod pa yan chad rdzogs par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ bum pa gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur gyi bar gzhung bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// bzhi pa ni/ gtor ma rnams chu gtsang gis bran te/ dang po tshe dpag med la/ gnyis pa chos skyong gur mgon dang zhal bzhi lta bu'am/ rgyal chen bzhi la dbul/ gsum pa phyogs skyong dang*/ bzhi pa 'byung po/ lnga pa bgegs gtor rnams gzhung bzhin du btang ngo*// gnyis pa mchog gi yul la bya ba la/ bla ma 1 lhar bskyed snga 2 gas bzlas mcho 3 da// gsol 4 gdab byin 5 rlabs brda mtshon 6 dbul// brtan bzhug 7 sa gsol bzhes 8 gtang rag dbu 9 la// rgyal tshab mnga'

10 gsol shis pa 11 brjod// ces pa ltar bcu gcig las/ dang po lhar bskyed pa ni/ zhabs brtan gang la 'bul ba'i yul gyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi bzhugs khri'i steng du/ stan dkar rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa btings la/ de'i steng du dpal ldan bla ma de nyid spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol lo// de nas las bum gyi chu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi sogs nas dbus dkar ba zhes pa'i bar gyis srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed la/ de'i dbus su rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri gzhom gzhig dang bral ba sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po'am dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par gdon mi za ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po sogs nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi skabs ltar las/ dbang lha'i gsol gdab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes mi brjod par de'i tshab tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes bsgyur ro// de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig las zhes pa nas/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus de nyid la thim par bsams/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon la sngags kyi yi ge kha dog dmar po sogs nas byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs te/

de nyid la thim pas bar du gcod pa thams cad byang zhing sku tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes la sogs pa rgyas par byas par bsams la/ sngags gsum po ci rigs par bzlas so// gsum pa ni/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i thog mar las kyi rdo rje zhig gis me tog bkye/ thams cad kyis zhabs brtan mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs te bzhag tshogs pa'i gtso bo zhig gis langs te maṇ+ḍal sum cu so bdun ma bkod pa lag pa g.yon du thogs nas g.yas pas spos reng thogs te brda sprod pa'i tshul dang bcas te/ thams cad kyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bskal brgyar brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba'i ched du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu zhes bskul nas/ thams cad kyis oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa zhes sogs nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bskal brgyar brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba'i ched du dbul bar bgyi'o zhes bsgyur nas/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir zhes pa man chad 'dra bar byas la/ spro na gang gi mchod rdzas sogs dang*/ deng nas byang chub nas/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi bar brjod/ mchod pa 'bul ba so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sku tshe brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas shab+da'i bar 'don pa bsgyur te ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra sogs dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// zhes sogs nas rgyal srid bdun dbul ba mtshan sngags gong bzhin sbyar ba'i khyad par min pa 'dra/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs nas bzhes shig

sku tshe brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhes dang*/ mtshan sngags gong bzhin gyi mthar/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa nas spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐ gi bar gyi 'dod yon lnga tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas mchod la/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs kyis bstod do// bzhi pa ni/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs rnams mngon sum du byon pa la thugs rgyud bskul ba'i gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bla ma'i sku tshe brtan zhing phrin las rgyas par byin gyis brlabs/ bstan srung nor lha rnams kyis bar chad kyi bgegs bsal bar bsams la/ thal mo sbyar te gdangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do// rgyal ba tshe dpag med mgon snying po'i zhabs// dgra las rnam rgyal byang chub bzang po dang*// ting 'dzin bzang po rdo rje gdan pa gnyis// ba ri lo tsā rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dir byon dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// sa skya bla chen dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs// rje btsun grags pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// shar pa rdo rje 'od zer bkra shis 'od// e pa 'khon ston rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dir byon dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal byang sems rgyal ye dang*// don ri grags chen sru lung kun smon zhabs// brag phug pa dang mtshungs med blo gros brtan// dpal ldan tshul khrims rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dir byon dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// shar chen ye rgyal ngor chen kun dga'i mtshan// mus chen dkon rgyal kun dga' dbang phyug dang*// rat+na war+dha sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs// sa skya lo tsā rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dir byon dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// lha mchog seng ge bud+dha siṃ ha dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang kun dga' bsod nams dang*// nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang zhabs// sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dir byon dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// tshul khrims lhun grub la sogs bka' srol gyi// dbang bskur gdams pa dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas// bstan srung nor sbyin rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// 'dir byon dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo// lnga pa ni/

bla ma dang tshe dpag tu med pa gnyis su med pa'i thugs kar rtsa bzhi pad 'dab bzhir gyes pa'i dbus su rnam snang tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ spyi bor ye shes tshe dpag med rnams bzhugs par bsams la/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te spyi bo'i ye shes tshe dpag med la thim/ mdun bskyed dang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams las kyang de 'dra ba spyan drangs te de nyid la thim/ ye shes tshe dpag med 'od du zhu tshangs bug nas zhugs te/ thugs ka'i rigs lnga'i spyi bor thim pas/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas sku thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du brtan par gyur nas/ phrin las gzhal du med pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur par bsam zhing sngags gsum po lan gcig gam gsum la sogs pa ci rigs par brjod pas brtan par bsam mo// drug pa ni/ bla ma'i phyag tu rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku bris 'bur gang yang rung ba zhig 'bul zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'pho 'gyur med par dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba'i brdar sku'i rten dbul bar bgyi'o// gsung rten tshe mdo'am glegs bam 'bul zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nas/ bsod nams kyi zhing du gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rtag tu zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par bskor bar gsol ba'i brdar gsung gi rten dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten nam pad spungs 'bul zhing*/

dus gsum sangs rgyas nas bsod nams kyi zhing du thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bden gnyis zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin zab mo las ma g.yos par dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes skye 'gro thams cad mi 'dor bar gsol ba'i brdar thugs kyi rten dbul bar bgyi'o// yon tan gyi rten du rnam rgyal bum pa 'bul zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas nas bsod nams kyi zhing du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bus sems can gyi re ba ma lus pa bskang bar gsol ba'i brdar yon tan gyi rten dbul bar bgyi'o// phrin las kyi rten du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan 'bul zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas nas bsod nams kyi zhing du 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du mdzad pa phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa bzhin du 'jug par gsol ba'i brdar phrin las kyi rten dbul bar bgyi'o// zhes dang*/ bla ma rang gi brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad gang rigs brjod do// bdun pa ni/ yun 'di tsam bzhugs kyi zhal bzhes zhu ba'i slad du/ tshogs pa'i gtso bo zhig gis phyag gsum byas nas thal mo sbyar te/ 'dren mchog bstan pa'i snang byed chen po'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing 'di skad du gsol ba mchis te/ ris bral skye 'gro'i bde skyid dpal// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas las byung*// bstan pa rgyas pa'ang bstan 'dzin gyi// skyes mchog rnams kyi phrin las gtso// gang phyir rgyal bstan spyi dang ni// bye brag bod khams ljongs 'di na// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dpyad gsum gyi// lam nas drangs pa'i legs bshad gtam// smra ba'i rgyal po sa skya pa// 'dir skabs su gang bab kyi zhabs brtan dbul bar bya ba de'i dmigs bsal brjod dgos kyang*/ 'dir ngor e waṃ pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po lta bu la dper mtshon na/ de tshul 'chad rtsom brtsad gsum gyis// smra mkhas grangs med rgyu skar khrod// zla ba ltar gsal e waṃ pa'i// lugs mchog phyogs dus gnas skabs kun// snang byed skyes bu dam pa khyod// bstan pa srid mthar rgyas phyir dang*// bdag sogs gdul bya'i dpal mgon du// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum// mi 'gyur nges pa lnga ldan bzhin// 'khor ba ji srid de srid bar// brtan bzhugs gsol ba 'debs bgyi na// 'di srid bzhugs par zhal bzhes kyi// gnang ba zhu la da ci gnang*// zhes pa'am/

de nyid tshig lhug par brjod par spro na/ spyir 'jig rten khams kyi skye 'gro mtha' dag gi bde skyid ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa la rag las shing*/ bstan pa rgyas pa'ang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi phrin las la rag las pa'i phyir/ deng dus sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs don tshul bzhin du smra ba'i rgyal po ni dpal sa skya pa ste/ de'i tshul chen 'chad rtsom brtsad gsum gyi sgo nas legs par smra ba'i dbang po rgyu skar gyi grangs dang mnyam par byon pa'i khrod na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar ches cher gsal ba rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po kun dga' bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ de nyid kyi lugs mchog phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du gsal bar byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa khyod nyid/ bstan pa rin po che yun ring du rgyas pa'i phyir dang*/ bdag sogs gdul bya rnams kyi dpal yon dam pa nyid du/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnam pa gsum nam yang mi 'gyur bar nges pa lnga ldan gyi mgon po bzhin du/ 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs kyin mchi na/ 'di srid cig bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhes bka' stsal zhu yin gda' na ci gnang*/ zhes zhu'o// brgyad pa ni/ bla ma de nyid nas kyang*/ gal te bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// sems can phan pa'i rgyur 'gyur na// mi lo brgya rtsa brgyad lhag sogs// gang 'dod 'tsho bar bla ma dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bdag /dbang bcu ldan par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa lta bu'i zhal bzhes gnang byung ba dang*/ dgu pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal rgya che ba thogs te/ thams cad kyis gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi nas tshom bu so bdun ma 'bul ba'i gsham du/ 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bskal brgyar zhabs kyi pad+ma brtan par bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir zhes sogs brjod do// bcu pa ni/

de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams lhan cig pas sku tshe la sogs pa la dbang 'byor ba thob pa'i phyir rgyal srid sna bdun dbul ba dang*/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dbul ba'i sgo nas bkra shis kyi cho gas phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa gtad par gyur/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs la/ oṃ na mo bh+rūm̐ ā yur+dzñā na hrīḥ.a ro lika hūm̐ hrīḥzhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ re re bzhin du thogs nas 'bul ba'i tshul dang bcas te/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum// rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang*// sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal 'gyur bar// 'khor lo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ gzhan rnams la'ang des 'gre'o// bcu gcig pa ni/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi gzugs bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mam̐ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe dang phrin las dang*/ dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa dra bya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ gzugs re re bzhin du thogs nas 'bul ba'i tshul dang bcas te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yang me long gi rdzas la brten nas sku tshe la dbang 'byor bar shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi zhes sogs nas yungs kar gyi bar dkyus ltar byas pa'i rjes su/ slar yang rgyal mtshan rtse mo la sogs pa dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs pa rgyas par brjod de me tog gi char dbab bo// gsum pa rjes ni/

mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha bsos/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis bstod la/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ rgyal chen bzhi rang gnas su gshegs/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs kyis ras bris la brtan bzhugs bya/ che ba'i che mchog la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// smras pa/ skyabs

gzugs can rgyan las ldan pa'i gzugs can/ kun 'dus pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dbyar// lus can bsod nams mgron du brtan byed pa// bsdebs legs cho ga'i khu byug rgyags pa'i glu// gsang chen bstan pa'i rkang thung phang par len// 'dab bsdus brjod las spyi'i bsdus brjod/ stong ge sar dgod par sbrang rtsi'i mgrin// 'phur lding dbyangs su blangs 'di mi mnyen na// me tog kha 'byed ma gyur gang bu'i phyir// bung bas 'khyud pa'i glu phyir rna ba gtod// rgyu las phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu/ rtun pa rmad byung lang tsho'i rims ma yin// brjod bya gzhan 'drid 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal min// rjod byed grong tshig min no mkhas rnams kyi// bzhed srol 'chad pa'i tshul 'dir bdag dga'o// ltos pa'i rab spel gyis mdzes pa/ spyi 'gros 'chi med grub pa'i lam po cher// byang chub bde ba'i gom pa rnam bkod de// khyad chos ma 'dres 'jug ngogs la bkri phyir// mtsho byung sgeg mo mgrin par lhags sam snyam// rnam thog ma dang bar du yod pa chod pa'i zung ldan gyi shis brjod/ dkar dge bas rnam mang skye dgu'i mgon// rnam mang bskal par rnam smin gzugs kyi sku// rnam gsum rdo rje'i rnam par mi phyed par// rnam grol lam gyis rnam mang don byed shog /ces bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la brten pa'i sku tshe brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga dbang bcu grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sngon chad 'di'i cho ga nyams su blang bde byas pa ma mthong ba dang*/ dad mos kyis rtsol ba byed pa rnams kyang grwa sa chen po'i phyag len mthong thos med par rang dgar mun nang 'dom 'jal lta bu'i tshod 'gros kyi cho ga byed pa zhig las ma byung bar/ phyis su grwa thang mkhan chen gyis rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i sku zhabs su dogs dpyod zhus tshe/

'don 'grigs tho zur gnang ba ltar/ dpal sa skya'i sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis pa dbus su chibs bsgyur gnang nas grwa thang du spyan 'dres zhus shing zhabs brtan 'bul ba'i tshe bsgrigs pa'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga sra brtan rdo rje'i lhun po zhes bya ba mdzad pa khungs btsun tshad ldan du mthong byung ba/ de gar rje tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi bdag mdun bum sgrub rnams la mchod phreng byang phug pa'i gsang 'dus kyi cho ga nas bsgrigs pa dang*/ brgyud 'debs gsar rtsom mdzad pa sogs de dag la sngar goms 'dris chung ba rnams la tshig gi khyad par gsar bskrun mang ba'i shugs kyis 'phral du nyams su lon bde ba ma byung bar brten/ 'dir ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa'i cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang la brten pa ni thun mong ba'i blo ngor nyams su len bde bar rtogs nas/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i 'bru mang zhes bya ba'i gnam lo'i chu stod zla bar lha'i bla ma rgyal sar phebs pa'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa'i tshes la/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i nye 'dabs su sbyar ba swa sti bi dza yan+tu// ༄༅// sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo la brten pa'i sku tshe brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga nyi bu'i bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// gang bai dharba'i mdzes pa'i yon tan bsngags pa la sbyar ba/ gi gsang gsum byin rlabs bskul ba'i 'phral// de nyid nas brtsams nyi bu'i dpung tshogs las// rnam rgyal bskal par 'tsho ba'i dngos grub dpal// mchog sbyin bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'dud// lhag yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can/ lha gcig tu dpag yas bsgrub bya'i lha// 'dus par thugs rgyud bskul ba'i tshul shes na// mngon 'dod dngos grub mchog sbyin dpag bsam gyi// yal ga brkyang la ring dang thung mi srid// 'on

bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ te gang 'tsham blo ngor thugs rje'i shugs// myur ma dpa' mo'i rnal 'byor la brten nas// skyabs mchog rnams kyi sku tshe bskal mang du// mi shigs rdo rjer bsgrub pa'i cho ga spel// de'ang skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon skyabs rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i dpal ldan bla ma mchog rnams zhabs brtan gyi cho ga sgrub pa la/ 'dir sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bdag mdun gyi cho ga la brten nas mdzad pa la mos pa rnams kyi ngor de nyid ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ cho ga'i 'gros phal cher tshe dpag tu med pa la brten pa gong du rgyas par bstan zin pa de nyid gzhir bzhag nas/ 'dir sgos chos rnams bstan pa la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po sbyor ba la/ mdun bskyed zhabs brtan yo byad gnyis// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po ni gza' skar dus tshes bzang bar bla ma'i bzhugs khri dang nye ba'i gnas su stegs bu la ras kyis bkab pa'i steng du man 'ji'i khar/ rdul tshon gyis pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su tshom bu dkar po bkod pa'i mthar byang shar du mtshams 'dzin nas nyer spyod rnams dang*/ byang shar nas shar lho'i bar zlum gtor gsum dang bgegs gtor rnams bsham mo// gnyis pa bla ma'i mdun phyogs la sogs pa gang bder zhabs brtan gyi mchod pa'i yo byad rnams las sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku bris 'bur gang yang rung ba min pa gzhan 'dra zhing*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa rgyan ldan gcig bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rang gi bya ba dang*/ mchog gi yul la bya ba'o// dang po la/ bdag mdu 1 na sgrub 2 mchod bum pa ba 3 sgrub// ye shes 'jig rten gtor ma 4 btang*// zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa'i cho ga dang*/

mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i zur 'debs ltar mchod rdzas oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣas bsang ba nas/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te bdag bskyed kyi mjug gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mdun bskyed tshom bu yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed cing mchod bstod bya ba/ bum pa bsgrub pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma btang ba/ mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa/ gsol gdab yan chad gzhung bzhan nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa mchog gi yul la bya ba la/ bla ma lha 1 ra bskyed sngags bzla 2 sa mchod 3 // gsol gad 4 ba byin brla 5 bas brda mtshon dbu 6 la// brtan 7 bzhugs gsol ba 8 zhes gtang ra 9 ga dbul// rgyal tshab mnga' 10 gsol shis 11 pa brjod// ces pa ltar bcu gcig las/ dang po ni/ zhabs brtan 'bul yul gyi bzhugs khri'i steng du/ stan dkar rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa btings pa'i khar/ bla ma de nyid spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol lo// de nas bla ma'i sku la dmigs te rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas bgegs bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri gzhom gzhig dang bral ba sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbus su/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po'am dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun ma yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba sogs nas 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar las/ dbang lha'i gsol gdab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ zhes mi brjod par/

de'i tshab tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes bsgyur ro// de nas oṃ gu ru tā re sar+b+ba bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod do// gnyis pa ni/ bla ma rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i lte bar/ oṃ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig hā zhes dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis tā re tut+tā re tu re swā zhes pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ bar chad dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs dang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang yig 'bru rnams la thim pas/ sku tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes la sogs pa rgyas par byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ yi ge bcu pa dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ā yur+puṇ+ya dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes pa'ang ci nus su bzla'o// gsum pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye/ zhabs brtan mchod pa rnams byin rlabs byas te bzhag la/ thams cad kyis maṇ+ḍal sum cu so bdun ma 'bul ba gsol ba gdab pa dang bcas pa tshe dpag med kyi skabs bzhin byas la/ mchod pa rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho kun rig ltar ram/ yang na tshe dpag med kyi skabs bzhin byas kyang legs pas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sku tshe brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ gu ru tā re sar+b+ba bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar 'don pa bsgyur la badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra sogs dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad nas/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ kha dog dbyibs legs nas bzhes shig sku tshe brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes 'dod yon lnga tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku zhes pa sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma zhes sogs kyis bstod do// bzhi pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs rnams mngon sum du byon pa la thugs rgyud bskul ba'i gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bla ma'i sku tshe brtan zhing phrin las rgyas par byin gyis brlabs/ bstan srung nor lha rnams kyis bar chad kyi bgegs bsal bar bsams la/ thal mo sbyar te gdangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug ston pa shākya'i tog /rje btsun sgrol ma paṇa chen shākya shrī// mkhan chen byang chub dpal dang bde ba dpal// grags pa gzhon nu rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// bsod nams grags pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// dpal ldan tshul khrims shar chen ye shes mtshan// ngor chen kun dga' bzang po mus chen rje// paṇa chen chos dpal rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// blo gros rgya mtsho rin chen bzang po dang*// sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams dkon mchog legs// dpal ldan don grub dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// bkra shis lhun grub rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// bka' srol byin rlabs dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas// bstan srung nor sbyin rnams ni gnas mchog 'dir// mchog tu dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku tshe bskal pa brgya ru bsring ba dang*// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'am bka' babs dgu ldan gyi brgyud pa gzhan gang la mos na'ang des rigs 'gre sbyar ro// 'di ni kha che'i lugs kyi brgyud pa ltar byas pa'o// lnga pa ni/

de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma dang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs thams cad 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub zla ba zhu ba'i khu ba lta bu dpag tu med pa byon te/ bla ma rje btsun mar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs te/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams las 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par babs pas sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du brtan par gyur nas/ phrin las gzhal du med pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur par bsam ste rang nyid de rnams dang mgrin gcig tu sngags bzla bar bsams shing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re saṅgu roḥ.ā yur+puṇ+ya dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa bdun la sogs pa ci rigs par bzlas pa'i mthar/ slar yang mdun bskyed nam mkha'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bla ma'i sku'i phyi rol du 'od de las grub pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa sbubs can zhwa theb kha sbyar ba lta bu sra zhing brtan pa'i phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur zhes bsam zhing brjod do// drug pa ni/ bla ma'i phyag tu rje btsun ma'i sku gzugs 'bul zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma sogs nas ma stongs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs par gsol ba'i brdar sku'i rten dbul bar bgyi'o// de bzhin du gsung rten tshe mdo 'bul ba/ thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten 'bul ba/ yon tan gyi rten du rnam rgyal bum pa 'bul ba/ phrin las kyi rten du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan 'bul ba rnams dang*/

bla ma rang gi brtan bzhugs 'don pa bcas gong gi tshe dpag med kyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// bdun pa ni/ yun 'di tsam bzhugs kyi zhal bzhes zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ ris bral skye 'gro'i bde skyid dpal zhes sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'am lhug pa gang mos brjod pas bka' stsal zhu ba/ brgyad pa zhal bzhes gnang ba/ dgu pa gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ bcu pa de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dang nged cag lhan cig pas sku tshe sogs la dbang 'byor ba'i phyir rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba/ bcu gcig pa bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'bul ba/ mthar bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgyas par brjod pa rnams kyang tshe dpag med kyi cho ga la brten pa'i skabs ltar bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa rnams kha bsos te mdun bskyed tshom bu'i lha la mchod bstod byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes sogs gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bshags nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyis ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes dang*/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// gzhan yang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi khrid thob cing nyams su len tshul shes pas ni/ de dang mthun pa'i bskyed chog thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal 'debs kyi dmigs rim dang*/

spyi bo'i rigs bdag tshe dpag med du gnas 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i sgos chos rnams dang*/ brgyud rim bsgyur ba sogs kyi khyad par ma gtogs pa'i cho ga thams cad 'di kho nas 'grub bo// slar yang smras pa/ sngags

mtha' dag gi gzugs can gyis mdzes pa/ gzhung dag byed phung po blo ldan gyi// me zhal rtsal gyis lan brgyar bsrubs pa'i bcud// skyes chen mchog rnams ring 'tshor brtan bzhugs kyi// 'chi med zil dngar bum pa bzang 'di thon// rin spyi'i bsdus brjod kyis spras pa/ thang chen pos nyer bsgrubs lwa ba yug /bzang yang byed pos tshad gzhal legs dras shing*// sgeg chas gos su ma drub de srid du// che mchog sku rgyan 'dod pa ga zha'i rgyu// bsdebs ting nge 'dzin gyi rab brtag legs rnam gsal bshad pa'i rgyud gcig las// lha gzhan brten pa'i cho ga cang 'byung ba// 'di 'dra sngon rabs tshangs pas ma dran par// bsting zhing 'gyod pas gnyid du ma yur snyam// tshogs rmongs pa'i dpes mdzes pa/ gsum tshar du dngar ba'i rjod byed glur// len pa gang tshe dbyangs kyi rgyal mo de// dgyes pa'i rgyud stong 'khrol zhes blo ldan yid// dga' ba'i gar gyis 'di na lan brgyar lhags// tshul shis brjod kyis spras pa/ 'dir rtun pa'i legs byas stobs bcu pa'i// chos kyi srog kar gyur pa'i 'dren pa rnams// sku tshe bskal mang 'tsho gzhes smin grol gyi// dga' ston ris bral 'gro la 'gyed phyir bsngo// zhes sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo la brten pa'i sku tshe brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga nyi bu'i bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni gong du smos pa'i dgos ched rnams kyis rgyud yongs su bskul bar brten ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis rab byung 'dod pa'i 'bru mang zhes bya ba'i gnam lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i yar tshes dge ba'i nyin sde dge lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i nye 'dabs kyi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/
slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
